companies.name: The Machine

contact.address: One World Trade Center, 65th Floor, New York, NY 10007

taglines: Unlock the next era of work.
It doesn’t replace marketers’ tools; it makes them more effective and predictive.
companies.shortDescription: AI-powered operating system that unifies people, tools, and data — enhancing creativity, eliminating silos, and streamlining workflows inside the stack marketers already use.
companies.description: Code and Theory built The Machine as marketing’s first agentic operating system — an intelligent infrastructure layer that activates a company’s existing stack via open APIs. It works inside Figma, Slack, Teams, Adobe, Jira, and performance dashboards, trained on each client’s brand, campaigns, audience data, and institutional knowledge. It handles competitive monitoring, brief generation, asset versioning, brand compliance, and performance optimization while humans focus on judgment and relationships.
proofPoints: 10x content volume without proportional headcount growth

quotes.speaker: Dan Gardner
quotes.title: Founder and Chairman, Code and Theory
quotes.text: Most marketing AI tools ask you to rip out your infrastructure and start over. The Machine does the opposite. It works where you work, improves and AI enables the tools you already use, and transforms existing operations into an agentic system.

quotes.speaker: Mark Penn
quotes.title: Chairman and CEO, Stagwell
quotes.text: The launch of The Machine, combined with our recent release of newvoices.AI and strategic partnerships with Palantir and Gradial, marks another milestone in cementing Stagwell as a leader in marketing AI.

companies.name: Agent Cloud
taglines: Giving the Modern Marketer Access to the Best AI—Safely
Enterprise-grade access to major LLMs, plus the ability to create custom AI assistants
companies.shortDescription: One login, one contract, and one security standard for leading multimodal LLMs, image/video tools, and custom marketing agents. Client data is not used to train models.
companies.description: Agent Cloud is a secure AI workspace that centralizes access to enterprise ChatGPT, Claude Sonnet, Grok, Gemini Pro, plus image and video tools, and lets teams build/share custom assistants for creative, media, communications, and research. It standardizes governance and eliminates unsanctioned AI use.

faq.whatIs: A secure AI workspace for marketers to access top LLMs and custom-built AI assistants through a single login.
faq.models: Enterprise ChatGPT, Claude Sonnet, Grok, Gemini Pro, image/video tools, plus third-party integrations for synthetic audiences, social listening, and citation-backed research.
faq.data: Uploaded data is never used to train LLMs. Role-based access. SOC 2 processes.
faq.pricing: One annual base fee plus usage-based charges.

companies.name: The Targeting Machine
companies.parent: The Marketing Cloud (Stagwell), powered by Palantir Foundry

caseStudies.name: GSTV + Conagra Brands
caseStudies.summary: GSTV is the first media network outside Stagwell to integrate SATS. 29,000+ locations, 115M unique US adults/month. Conagra (Slim Jim, FATTY, Duke's) is the first GSTV advertiser using SATS.

quotes.speaker: Peter Choi
quotes.title: VP Marketing, Conagra
quotes.text: GSTV's integration with the Stagwell Agentic Targeting System gives us a more dynamic view of the convenience retail audience allowing us to move beyond static demographic assumptions and toward real-time behavioral insights.

quotes.speaker: Lauren Lazarus
quotes.title: SVP Insights & Analytics, GSTV
quotes.text: The Stagwell Agentic Targeting System fundamentally changes how we build and target audiences for campaigns, enabling us to target the right people at the right locations, in real time, based on far richer signals than traditional demographic or survey-based data.

companies.shortDescription: Privacy-first audience platform that fuses first-party data with the Stagwell ID Graph and proprietary consumer intelligence, then lets marketers query and activate audiences conversationally on Palantir Foundry.
companies.description: SATS is an enterprise-grade audience intelligence platform built natively on Palantir Foundry. It uses the Stagwell ID Graph (260 million US consumers / 123 million US households) to connect attitudinal and behavioral signals, generate predictive segments, and activate campaigns. A Differential Privacy Vault based on Harvard OpenDP protects individual identities.
